batting.dismissal: c WG Jacks b DL Chahar

batting.dismissal: c Naman Dhir b KV Sharma

balls.text: Full toss around off, Dhir flicks it away behind square, and that's great fielding in the deep. The throw is a good one, too good in fact, as it hits the stumps and deflects away, allowing them to run four!
ON a length close to off, Jacks can only miscue a pull to deep midwicket

Porel holds on in the deep! Wide yorker from Mukesh, Tilak goes across the stumps and looks to sweep this. Hits it high, but not far enough. Porel at deep midwicket is standing at the edge of the rope and holds on, without falling back. He is on one leg as he takes it, but makes it look all too easy! Tilak departs for 59 off 33
Goes very full and wide, Dhir toe-ends a drive that goes to deep cover on the bounce
Lucky! Another low full toss just outside off, and this time Dhir goes across again and just helps it very fine on the leg side. Beats the keeper and short fine leg
Tilak slices this wide yorker high, but it drops short of deep third! Sub fielder Karun Nair throws it back quickly.
It was such a great over right until this very moment! Low full toss outside off, and Dhir just goes across the stumps, gets low and flicks this behind square leg. 14 runs off that over in the end
Full outside off, driven out to long-off

Low full toss on middle, flicked out to deep midwicket. Almost a runout chance too as Dhir had run halfway down for the second while Tilak was ball-watching before he spotted his partner and told him to turn back. Gets back safely in the end even as the throw comes to Rahul, who misses his attempt at the stumps. He would have been in anyway
Digs out this yorker outside off to cover for a quick single. Axar has a shy at the non-striker's and a direct hit would have seen Dhir running back to the dugout

Another collision! And that's a chance gone begging as well! Tilak takes on a full ball angled across him and ends up slicing it. Ashutosh at backward point and Mukesh at short third converge and Ashutosh, who had his right arm outstretched ends up not being able to hold on. Both players look hurt
Starts off with a wide yorker but Dhir is also standing outside off. Reaches out and carves it out to deep point
Another wide yorker but this time Tilak is wise to it. Reaches out and slices it over the vacant backward point region. Three boundaries off the over!
Wide yorker beats Tilak. He looks to swing acfross the line but the ball sneaks under the bat

Almost a screamer of a catch, but in the end it's five runs saved! Length ball around off and Dhir slaps it down the ground. Axar, running to his right from long-off leaps and takes it high above his head at full stretch. He realises he is losing his balance due to his momentum, but manages to throw it in before tumbling over the rope. It will go down as a drop technically, but in reality, it's just an excellent fielding effort
Brilliantly placed! Just short of yorker length and Dhir drills it through midwicket. JFM runs and dives to his left from deep midwicket, but Dhir got it straight enough of him

Just helped over short fine! Dug into the pitch around off and it's angled across Dhir, who swivels and hooks it. Could have gone to the fielder on another day, but today, he's done enough to get it over him
Starts off with a brilliant wide yorker at 142kph. Just inside the line and Dhir can't get his bat down on time

Mohit nails the yorker! And that could be a huge blow as the finger goes up. Tilak Varma reviews immediately. This was a yorker on length. Tilak jammed his bat down but the ball snakes through. Did he get an edge on that? No bat, but also, it's pitching outside leg, so Tilak survives!
Slower ball, short outside off, Dhir can only swat it out to deep cover
Full toss outside off, Tilak drives it out to long-off to bring up his second half-century of the season, off just 26 balls. Both of those have come after he was retired out earlier in the season
Short ball sits up nicely for Tilak, who waits on it before hammering a pull in the gap at square leg
Mohit responds with a yorker outside off that Dhir is able to squeeze out towards cover for a single
That's gone high and very far! Short ball climbs onto Dhir, and he swivels and pulls it hard. Goes fine on the leg side and into the crowd
Legbreak outside off again, Tilak slaps it away through cover. Fraser-McGurk in the deep does well to keep it down to two, running to his left and sliding to stop the boundary
Legbreak on a length outside off and it spins away to beat Tilak's attempted reverse-sweep
Tilak swings and misses This is full outside off and it stays quite low as Tilak looks to hit the leather off that
Full outside leg, tucked to short fine for a single
Length ball outside off, Tilak slaps it away in front of point

Two deep fielders collide again, and it results in another Tilak Varma boundary! Shortish outside off and Tilak pulls it hard in front of midwicket. Starc and Ashutosh almost crash into each other and they aren't able to stop the ball as it ends up rolling to the rope
Legbreak floated up on off, Naman Dhir pushes it out to the off side
Full and flat on middle and off, Tilak tucks it in the vacant mid-on region for a quick single
On a length outside off, Tilak pushes it to backward point
Tilak ain't stopping! This is in the slot just outside off and he plays another handsome lofted drive straight down the ground!
Tossed up full around leg, Dhir backs away and drives it along the ground to long-off

And Vipraj sends Hardik packing! Vipraj tosses it full on leg to cramp Pandya, who still clears his front leg and looks to drive it down the ground. All he does is pick out long-off and this time Stubbs makes no mistake. Two wickets in two overs
Tossed up on leg, Tilak eases it to fine leg
On a length around middle and off, Hardik backs away and cuts it to deep point
Big turning legbreak outside off, Tilak manages to pull it in front of square
Length ball outside off, Hardik cuts it out to deep point
Tossed full on leg, he tucks it towards square leg

Kuldeep does break the partnership! What a player! This is floated full around middle, this was also the wrong'un, SKY comes down the track and wants to go down the ground but slices it a little. Starc isn't dropping those at long-off. This could be a momentum-shifting moment in the match. SKY was just looking like he was getting in his groove
Fired in quicker and flatter. Tilak looks to cut but misses
Tucks this off his pads through midwicket

That's gone high and it's dropped! Tossed in the slot outside off, Tilak goes for the big swing down the ground. Stubbs is running from long-on to his left and he is worried about JFM running in from deep midwicket and that takes his focus off the ball slightly. Enough to make a meal of it as it bursts through his hands above his head
Tossed full outside off, SKY this time laces a drive to long-off
And now he fetches it from outside off with a sweep! Length ball outside off and he sweeps it away in front of square!
Slogged away! This is tossed full around off and he gets in position and hammers it over square leg!
Hold the pose! Length ball around off going across, and Tilak plays through the line, just playing a punchy lofted drive down the ground and that's gone all the way
Very full around off, Suryakumar gets low and drives it out to long-on. Think he was looking to play this on the off side but it comes off the inside half of the bat
Tilak sees a full length ball angled across him and shapes up for the big heave. Only manages to inside edge it onto his pad as the ball rolls towards point. Another leg bye for Mumbai Indians
SKY tries that wristy flick again, but misses this time as it goes off his pad to short third. They take the leg bye. This was full outside off, and Mohit appeals, but impact was well outside off
Mohit responds with a bouncer, but it's a wayward one. Flies down leg
Classic Surya! This is full outside off, right in the slot, and he whips it high in front of square leg. It's placed in the gap and it goes for a one-bounce four. His strong wrists on display!
Starts off with a pace-on delivery. A length ball around off at 133kph. Suryakumar works it to midwicket's right but can't get it past the fielder
Now Tilak brings out the sweep This is full on leg, Tilak gets low and swipes across the line, maybe a bit of a top edge there but it goes well over the short fine leg fielder
Full around off again, SKY squeezes it square on the off side and this time gets a single
Pushed through full around off, Suryakumar punches to point

Gets this length ball to come in with the angle from outside off, Surya is late to bring his bat down. KL Rahul with a loud appeal for lbw as that brushes SKY's pad, and he's convinced his skipper to review this. Replay confirms that hit his pad before bat. And that's going down leg. Capitals lose a review
SKY brings out the sweep! Flighted full on middle and he lofts it well over short fine!
Tossed full around middle, Tilak whips it along the ground to deep midwicket
Guides it from outside off through point

Sharp spin and bounce deceives SKY. Length ball landed just down leg and rushed off the pitch, the batter shaped to sweep and then tried to block it straight but couldn't adjust in time. Got it off the shoulder of the bat to point
Length ball seemed to have straighten to off, punched off the back foot to long-on
Tilak doesn't attack Kuldeep right away. Not given much air, 86ks length ball on middle spins in. Punched defensively with the straight bat
Fullish on middle, 88ks but looked quite quicker than the last ball, flicked to deep midwicket
Swept probably for two... no it'll be four. Really well placed, Ashutosh ran right from deep square leg but couldn't stop it despite the dive. Was an 87ks full ball on fourth
Slow on a length, 86ks, flicked off the pads to short fine leg
Full ball is pushed to long-off
Touch short. Slow and around either leg or off. Hard to tell as the batter made room late. Punched to cover
Bunts it off the back foot through the off side

Reverse swept for six! Outrageous shot over backward point. Rising length ball on off stump, would be leg stump as Tilak shuffled his feet - got the back leg in the crease too - to get into a right-hander's position and biff it with no half measures
Length on fourth, driven off the back foot to deep point
Goes back and punches the fifth-stump length ball to cover
Another googly but this started wide and Tilak pulls it from deep in the crease. Porel didn't have much ground to cover from deep midwicket, went left and was mid-air as the ball raced past him

Ripping googly flattens middle stump. Yeah, back of the hand with a slinky-like cross-seam, loads of revs, lands on the shorter side of length around fourth and Rickelton shaped to cut it square. The horizontal bat was diagonal as he was caught between shots. He didn't account for the spin and missed it completely. Kuldeep runs with his arms spread, leaps too, heck of a ball.
Quicker this time. 92ks, on a fuller side of length on off, SKY goes back and punches it to long-on
Gives it air. Overpitched on fourth, punched back to the bowler
Gets turn right away, touch slow though. Stock ball on a length landed on off and spun away, Rickelton pulls it through midwicket
Full on fourth, driven to long-off

Chance... no, clears long-off. That was toed by Rickelton, he reached away full-length to a 92ks length ball well outside off while making room. Didn't look like he'd be in reach but went through with the shot with a flat bat
Sweeps the full ball to deep-backward square

Sharp turn away to beat the edge. Think it's the first time a ball's turned square. Legbreak on a length lands on off and goes through fourth, SKY tried to punch through cover. Was too late to check the shot, lucky to not get an edge. 95ks
Cuts a length ball on fourth to short third
Swept hard, through square leg. Smashes the boundary cushion in front of MI's dugout. A cross-seam topspinner on a length at fourth stump. Not a bad ball
Full, loopy ball down leg goes past the sweep
Full on off, driven to mid-off. Bat-face opened upon impact
Yeah, but not on the pads. Heart of a length, top of off, punched back to the bowler
Goes for it again but the ball's slightly shorter and doesn't bounce. Down leg, Rahul takes it on the bounce. He isn't happy with the bowler

Helped away below the Gautam Gambhir stand. Trademark stuff from SKY, gets deep in the crease and across to off stump to a length ball at the stumps. Top-of-stump height and he flicks it high over fine leg. 82-metre six
Similar shot, the ball's fuller and the ball goes to the right of cover point. JFM, stationed at the deep, stops it
Wide on a length, driven to cover point
Rickelton does line him up. Was a touch short and he pulled it with disdain over midwicket

Good appeal for lbw, not given. DC review. Rohit was beaten on the slog sweep and got hit on the back leg right in front of middle. Ball went below bat. Was a length ball that he tried to hit square while on one knee. Was a legbreak on a shortish length, landed on off and skidded straight. Ball-tracking shows it'd go on to hit leg stump. Rohit sighs and Rickelton grimaces with closed eyes as DC celebrate
Full on fourth, driven to cover
Short ball, gets away with it. That landed behind the halfway mark on the pitch and rose above stump height outside off, Rickelton pulled it to long-on. Didn't try to hit it hard
Goes back and works the length ball back to the bowler
Leading edge off the close-faced flick goes through where first slip would've been. Short third stops it. Good ball. On a length, angling away through off. Looked like the legbreak, went straight.
Full on off, punched to long-off
On-the-rise cover drive through extra. A perfectly good length ball angling away through fourth, Rickelton presses forward and whacks it. A top-hand shot with full follow-through
Full on off, driven into the pitch with a closing bat-face. Bowler leaps out with the right hand to half-stop it and deny the single
Length on middle and leg, flicked softly to midwicket for a quick single
Heave and a miss. Rohit dances down late to the 137ks shortish ball over leg stump, tried to pull it over midwicket. Rohit rushes back into the crease, no throw from the keeper though
Fullish on off, defended to cover. 137ks, bounce was a touch low again. Skiddy
Square drives a wide-ish ball to deep point

Arguably the shot of the over. An aerial cover drive with the shape held. Was a cutter on a full length outside off, looked pacy to the eye though. Just creamed flat, bounced well over the boundary board
Cutter on a length beats bat. Angles away through fourth, Rohit tried to block it towards cover. On the bounce to the keeper

Top edge off the scoop goes into the sightscreen behind the wicket. Was a pre-meditated shot to a 147ks full ball angling away through fourth. Rohit was on one knee and wanted to paddle it softly, but the ball rocketed high and far
Nails the square drive to the left of cover point. Three-quarter length ball angling away through fourth, played late. On top of the bounce too
Lobs up... but doesn't carry to Mohit at mid-on, he ran forward and tried to scoop the ball up from the grass but got half-volleyed. Was a full ball that Rickelton flicked. Went off the leading edge

Good ball but goes to the fine-leg boundary. Starc tucks the batter up with a shortish ball, it's over leg stump and hurried Rickelton on the back-foot glance. It was tentative and the ball went into the ground and wide of the keeper
Fullish on middle, worked to mid-on's right
Short, and Rickelton's mauled that. Sat up just under rib-height, the scramble-seam cutter on fourth rose at an even pace, free bat swing takes it 80 metres far
Hard length on fourth, punched off the back foot with a vertical bat, to cover
Leading edge... goes on the bounce to first slip's left. Rickelton tried to flick the fullish ball through square leg, didn't go too hard at it which saved him
Good ball, skidding towards off from a three-quarter length. The angle in had Rohit try and defend it straight, got it off the inside-half towards midwicket
Flicks the fullish ball on the pads to mid-on's right for a quick single
More away swing, Rickelton tries to drive it through cover. Slightly on the up, gets it off the bottom of the bat to deep-backward point
Full ball down leg goes straight on. Past the flick
Length on top of front pad, beats the flick

Swings away a touch, but Rickelton punches it sweetly through cover. Was a full ball on off stump, fair to call it a half-volley but to play it with the movement in the air, with an open-faced bat was skilful
On the pads, whipped and that races along the ground through midwicket. Fullish ball went straight on, rose just under the knee roll and the batter used the angle
Full, and a bit of away swing. Worked off off stump to mid-on

No swing, squared up a bit but Rohit defends with soft hands. Off the outer-half of the full-faced bat to point. Was a length ball on off that didn't bounce much, Rohit had to lean forward quite a bit

Another run-out! Mumbai Indians have won it! A hat-trick of run-outs and Mumbai Indians players are jumping over each other! Mumbai Indians win their second game of the season! Incredible scenes at the Kotla! Mohit whipped this out towards mid-on and took off but a direct hit does the job!

On a length on middle and Kuldeep swings this away to deep midwicket. They run two again and there's a run-out chance again! Kuldeep is juuuuust short! Two run-outs in two balls and Hardik Pandya is delighted! This has been some implosion from the league leaders!

Yorker on off, he digs it out through point and they race for two. The throw at the striker's end is good and Rickelton takes off the bails. Did he make it back in time? No, he's caught short! The twists keep coming! That was an excellent through, and with Bumrah in his way, Ashutosh was slowed down a little and in the end, those fine margins count for a lot! Should he have just trusted Starc to face the last two balls? Probably! But Mumbai Indians know they are on top here!

Outside edge runs away for four now! Bumrah goes for the yorker but it's a low full toss outside off. He jams his bat down and the edge is thick enough to take it wide of the keeper and well fine of short third!
Reverse-scooped over short third! Full toss on leg, and he manages to get under it and get it over the fielder!
Steps out early to Bumrah, who goes very full on leg. He ends up yorking him self and he glances it through his own legs to long leg. They don't take a single!
Full outside off, Ashutosh Sharma now drills this flat to long-off, but on the bounce
Tossed up full and wide, Starc frees his arm and hammers it flat and on the bounce to long-on
Santner bowls this one outside the wide line as he tries to keep it out of Starc's hitting arc

Outfoxes him! Santner has been so good today! He anticipated that the batter would give him charge and bowls it short and outside off, getting it to spin away. Nigam is halfway down the track trying to hit that and Rickelton does the rest as Nigam misses
Full on the stumps, driven out to long-off
Misses the slog this time! Santner gets this to go on with the angle and it stays under the bat as Nigam has a wild swipe at it. The ball goes off his body to short third and they get a leg bye
Finds the gap on the off side! Skips across the stumps as Santner targets the wide line and cuts it away between point and backward point!
Vipraj does target him straight away! Jumps down the track to turn this full ball into a slot ball and creams it down the ground
Drills this yorker on leg to mid-off and they sprint for the single!

Nigam goes across the stumps and looks to scoop this full ball outside leg, but misses. And he reviews it for wide not given! The batter had moved quite a bit across the stumps and the third umpire upholds the on-field umpire's decision
Very full around leg, eased out to mid-off again. This time they get the single
Another yorker on leg! Squeezed out to mid-off this time. Vipraj took off for a single but Ashutosh sends him back
Boult nails two yorkers in a row! This time it's around middle and leg and Ashutosh jams his bat down to hit it onto his left foot
Slower yorker around off, he squeezes it out towards point and they take a very risky single! A direct hit would have seen Ashutosh running straight back to the dugout

Chance goes down? Yep, that will go down as a drop. Shortish outside off, Vipraj ends up spooning it back to Karn's right. Karn sticks his hand out to catch it but it bursts through and it also just beats the stumps. Could have been a run out at the non-striker's end as well!
Slides this length ball down leg for a wide
On a length around off, whipped away along the ground to deep square leg
Tossed up full around off, driven out to deep point

Top edge goes high and Karn holds on! That is HUGE! Tossed up on the stumps, Rahul goes to sweep. The ball spins back in from around leg and takes the top edge and balloons up. Karn claimed it, got under it and finished the job! His third wicket, and what a big one at this juncture!
Full around off, driven out to the off side for a single
Rahul gives charge as Karn throws this full around middle and leg. Looks to swing it leg side but gets a leading edge that flies over the infield and out to deep cover on the bounce
Drives this full delivery out to deep point to take an easy single
Inside edge! Length ball outside off comes in with the angle as Ashutosh looks to drive towards cover. The ball luckily for the batter deflects through backward square
On a length around off, Rahul goes back to ease it into the vacant midwicket area, sending Santner on a ball-chase
Dropped short outside off and Rahul latches onto it, cutting it hard in front of sweeper cover, but Will Jacks does well to stop it
Tossed up full outside off, Ashutosh eases a drive to long-off
Tossed full outside off, Rahul drives it to point for a risky single! Direct hit would have seen him in trouble at the non-striker's end
Tossed up full outside off, Rahul gets on one knee and slogs it flat down the ground. Takes a couple of bounces on its way to long-on
Drag down, and Rahul says thank you very much! Rocks back and pulls it into the gap behind square leg. 150 up for DC
That's an innocuous short-ish ball around leg, Ashutosh eases a pull out through fine leg to the deep fielder

Four wickets in four overs now! Stubbs looks to mow this slot ball dopwn the ground but ends up skying it off the toe end. It goes very high in the air and Naman Dhir gets under it, waits on it, and hangs on! The changed ball does wonders. Pressure building on Capitals!
Tossed up full on middle, Stubbs digs it out to mid-off but can't get a run
Nearly a return catch! Legbreak on a length on leg, Stubbs fends at it and it pops back to the bowler, but falls just short
Low full toss around off, squeezed out to cover
Another low full toss, outside off this time, Stubbs opens the face to guide it to deep third

Leading edge pops to cover, and Bumrah delivers! His first wicket of the season! This is an attempted yorker that turns into a low full toss going down leg. Axar looks to glance it fine but only gets that leading edge. Easy as you like it for SKY at cover. Bumrah chuckles and gives Axar a pat on the back as he walks off
Bumrah's riposte is the leg-stump yorker and Axar is able to jam his bat down in time to keep it out. That was fired in at 144kph!
Axar Patel slaps Bumrah down the ground! On a length around off, Axar skips out, backs away and thwacks this over mid-off! One-bounce boundary. "I can do this too, Karun," says his skipper!
On a length around middle and off, Axar stays leg-side of the ball and blocks this away towards mid-off
On a length outside off, cut away to deep point for a single
Axar finds the gap! Right in the slot outside off and he swings it away wide of long-on. The fielder ran hard and put in the dive, but he can't stop that

Santner knocks Nair over with a jaffa! It had to be something special to end a knock this special, and Nair falls for 89! This is on a length around off, and spins away as Nair looks to defend. Beats the outside edge and kisses the top of off. Brilliant delivery, but Nair has set his team up here in a big chase with a special, special knock. We'll be talking about this one for days to come!
Finds the gap with precision! Santner drags it down outside off, Nair rocks back, frees his arms and bisects long-on and deep midwicket
On a length around off, Rahul goes back to push it in front of point
Dropped short around off, Rahul's bottom hand comes off as he loses shape while pulling. Gets a couple to deep midwicket though
Conventional sweep now! Full around middle and he hammers it along the carpet behind square leg. Sublime, sublime stuff! He is 15 away from a maiden IPL century now!
Karun Nair's fireworks continue! On a length around off and Nair reverse-swats it over short third! One bounce four
Tossed full on leg, Rahul eases it away in front of square on the leg side to get off the mark
Tossed up full around off, Rahul blocks on the front foot

Caught out this time! Karn gets his revenge. This is full on off, fired in flatter. He gets low and looks to slog sweep this in front of square. Naman Dhir running to his right makes it look easy as he takes it around chest-height. Porel walks off just as he was looking to take off
Absolutely pummelled! This is tossed up around off and he skips down the track and swings it over deep midwicket. Into the Kotla stands!
Picked up off a length, over backward square it goes. Line was around off. Another great shot
Slower one's carted, sweeper cover is in place but that's carved flat to his left. Three-quarter-length offcutter landed close to the tramline and spun in but Nair's form is too good
Risky run to backward point. No direct hit at the striker's, but replays show Nair would've made it. Slow low full toss outside off was driven softly
Under-edge bounces before Rickelton tips it towards fine leg. Nair had a hack at a shortish length ball over the stumps
Length on fifth, tapped on the head to point
Yorker on fourth, jammed to backward point. Nair took off and was sent back, the throw is wide and without much power on it
Belts the length ball on fifth to long-on
Lifted cover drive is off the bottom of the bat, but it lands midway into the outfield before heading towards deep cover. Was a floaty full ball outside off
Beaten on the sweep this time, impact the issue again - likely outside off. The fullish ball deflected fine, short third runs to the outfield to stop it

Beaten on the reverse sweep. Ball hits pad, not given lbw. MI review. Both of Nair's feet were spread on the crease, the full legbreak landed on off and spun away. it him on the right leg. Impact umpire's call, wickets missing.
Slog swept off the stumps. 97ks length ball at the stumps, Nair got inside the line of the ball and walloped it with a high hand speed. Didn't follow-through fully, more of a whippy shot

Jacks comes in from deep midwicket... but can't take a skimmer. Oh, he got to it, but it was hit flat and coming low. He was sliding on his knees and tried to take it with both hands. Ball popped out. Was a full ball on the pads that was flicked
Reverse pull is beaten. Think Nair wanted to reverse ramp but the slower (124ks) ball outside off was on a back of length. Nair twirled fully and went hard at it
Full outside off, driven to cover. Looked slow

No missing this time, he moves again and paddles the 135ks low full toss over short fine. Missed yorker but not by much, line was okay too as the batter started moving just before Pandya released the ball. Just too good a shot
First time Nair's missed a shot while trying to get one up over the bowler. He crabbed across outside off and tried to scoop the fullish ball on fifth, missed it and got hit flish on the pad
Wide and full, square driven to deep point's right
Full on off, driven to long-off
Length on fourth, cut to point
Loopy and wide, gets spin and bounce. Just 77ks. Cut gently to deep point
Full on the pads, flicked through the leg side
Full ball down leg, Porel shaped to play it but got out of the way
Sits up from a length and Porel pulls through square leg. He ensures he doesn't go back onto the stumps after swivelling
He's happy to have a sighter. Length on leg, clipped to deep midwicket
Slightly short, spins in a touch towards top of off, cut to point

Nair brings up a 22-ball fifty, his first one in the IPL in seven years. The bat's high over his head for a while, all his team-mates applaud. He's taken on the best bowler on continuously by making room, as he does again. Bumrah went for a pace-on yorker. Was a full toss following Nair, the aerial flick wasn't middled but landed in the outfield and went well to the left of deep square leg
Both outfielders are on the leg side and Nair lofts it inside out over extra. Nair was smiling as he hit the slower full ball up from the stumps. Unreal
Slower yorker is loopy. Length is perfect, line's on fourth. Nair makes room again and stabs it towards point
Nair's bettering the best. Makes room and carves a missed yorker. Shin-high full toss at the stumps is driven behind the diving point fielder
Trustee yorker. Pace on, around off, Nair's leg side of it and manages to smother it with the face if the bat thudding into the ground
Not yet though, Nair picks him up off a length. The ball was rushing over leg stump but the batter slid leg side and flicked it over backward square leg for an 83-metre six
Another yorker, this is on the crease. Dug out to the bowler
Good ball. Attempted yorker, turned out to be a very low full toss. Flicked from in front of the body to deep square leg
Nair's going all in. Sees width, hacks over cover point. Was a cutter on a back of length just outside off. Batter waited till opening his hips late and slashing
Looks for another aerial pull, toes the ball onto pad. Ball dribbles towards midwicket. Was a 122ks length ball angling in towards off
Low fully outside off, scythed to point
Bouncer has no pace off the pitch. Rose to around-chest height, Porel waited on the pull but still smashed it in front of square. Over deep-forward point, which was unmanned

Makes room and carves the slower one to point's right. Right between him and cover point. More pre-meditation though, hopping late to the leg side. Bumrah went back of length around fourth. Ball bounced evenly off the pitch
Pushes the low full toss down the ground
Statement drive from Nair, inside out over cover to a 142ks fll ball on middle and leg. He hopped leg side very late, still before the bowler released the ball, but nailed it
Similar again, this is punched wide of mid-off. Hardik charges and slides to deny the quick outfield from taking over

Quick single to cover, direct hit deflects to midwicket's left. Santner there, was moving right but did well to go the other side and dive to deflect it towards square leg. Was a fullish pace-on ball outside off that was punched
Slowy to start. Fullish offcutter at 118ks on off, Porel read it. Defends it to point

Porel is late to take off, but goes through with the run. Bumrah hits the non-striker's stumps from short third but there is no third-umpire referral. Was a length ball that went off the thigh pad after beating the flick
That's a proper toe. Off the tip of the bat towards point. Nair tried to heave the length ball outside off, across over midwicket
Nair gloves a pull wide of the keeper, still very fine. Into the pitch, off the hips, the angle allowed him to help it away
Flicked behind square off the stumps

Sticks in the pitch, ball pops up off the bat but goes in the gap between cover and point. Sweeper cover was in place but the ball landed halfway into the outfield. Was a length ball looked to have moved away laterally, Nair went for the vertical-bat punch through cover. The pitch misbehaving had him early on the shot
Length around fourth, square driven to deep-forward point
Length on off, defended to point
Overpitched and Nair's threaded it through cover with a lovely punch. There is a check and holding of the shape

Late swing gives five wides. Full ball started on the pads but swung down, Nair shaped to flick before leaving it, Rickelton dove full length to the left and got a glove on it. Didn't stop it from going to the boundary
Miscommunication. Nair wants the run, is sent back as Rohit comes in from point and throws. No direct hit. Was a length ball, scramble seam, on the back leg that beat the pull

Cut well, a bit like Steve Smith from Nair. The flash of the bat is quick but the follow-through stops around when bat's in line with the front shoulder. Deep point's beaten to the left this time, in fact he didn't move
No swing and Nair drives it on top of the bounce. Deep point's in place but it's well to his right. Was a length ball angling away through fifth, was an attempted inswinger
Length on leg, flicked to deep square leg.
Similar ball, 138ks, Nair tries to whip it fine. Misses, ball goes off the pad to the keeper's left, he stops it
LBW appeal turned down, looked too straight. Fullish ball swung in and beat the flick, impact was outside leg as it hit front pad
Swing in again, nicely driven. Mid-on stops it
Overpitched and Porel nails the cover drive. With a flourish too. Ball was swinging in towards fourth stump, batter played in front of the body

Big inswinging yorker on off, Nair does well to jam it towards point. Kept the hands soft, so the bat-face opened. Tilak swoops in from backward point and underarms a direct hit at the striker's but the batter is in

Golden duck for JFM and it's a super softy. Reaches out to a 132ks fullish ball outside off, wanted to drive through cover but pushed at it way too early. Was too late to check the shot and the ball spooned straight to the infielder.
